```yaml
name: PX4 Metadata Sync

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'mavlink'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download PX4 metadata
        run: |
          curl -L -o src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4/AirframeFactMetaData.xml https://artifacts.px4.io/Firmware/_general/airframes.xml
          curl -L -o src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4/PX4ParameterFactMetaData.xml https://artifacts.px4.io/Firmware/_general/parameters.xml

      - name: Configure git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Check for changes
        id: diff
        run: |
          git diff --quiet || echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.diff.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git add src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4/AirframeFactMetaData.xml src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4/PX4ParameterFactMetaData.xml
          git commit -m "chore: update PX4 metadata"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/px4-metadata-update

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.diff.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8
        with:
          title: "chore: update PX4 metadata"
          body: |
            This PR updates the bundled PX4 metadata to the latest version from artifacts.px4.io.
          branch: px4-metadata-update
          delete-branch: true
```
